entry.description: A second fix of a buffered event, such as `All` in an appender behind a `Partial` buffer, no longer captures the identity, location, thread name and properties of the thread that flushes the buffer. Off the thread delivering the event, a later fix captures only the message, exception text, domain and user name; it captures no properties at all, not even the event's own, and `LoggingEvent.Fix` does not report the identity, location, thread name and properties it left out. This also applies to a second fix outside a logging call, for example `Fix = Partial` then `Fix = All` on the same thread. During a fix the message is rendered directly, without calling an override of `RenderedMessage` (ANT-2026-BH0P93PP, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
